methods.summary: Return this byte slice as a `&mut BStr`.

methods.name: bytes
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the bytes in this byte string.

methods.name: char_indices
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the Unicode scalar values in this byte string along with their starting and ending byte index positions. If invalid UTF-8 is encountered, then the Unicode replacement codepoint is yielded instead.

methods.name: chars
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the Unicode scalar values in this byte string. If invalid UTF-8 is encountered, then the Unicode replacement codepoint is yielded instead.

methods.name: contains_str
methods.signature: fn contains_str<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, needle: B) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this byte string contains the given needle.

methods.name: ends_with_str
methods.signature: fn ends_with_str<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, suffix: B) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this byte string has the given suffix.

methods.name: escape_bytes
methods.summary: Escapes this byte string into a sequence of `char` values.

methods.name: fields
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the fields in a byte string, separated by contiguous whitespace (according to the Unicode property `White_Space`).

methods.name: fields_with
methods.signature: fn fields_with<F: FnMut(char) -> bool>(&self, f: F) -> FieldsWith<'_, F>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the fields in a byte string, separated by contiguous codepoints satisfying the given predicate.

methods.name: find
methods.signature: fn find<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, needle: B) -> Option<usize>
methods.summary: Returns the index of the first occurrence of the given needle.

methods.name: find_byte
methods.summary: Returns the index of the first occurrence of the given byte. If the byte does not occur in this byte string, then `None` is returned.

methods.name: find_byteset
methods.signature: fn find_byteset<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, byteset: B) -> Option<usize>
methods.summary: Returns the index of the first occurrence of any of the bytes in the provided set.

methods.name: find_char
methods.summary: Returns the index of the first occurrence of the given codepoint. If the codepoint does not occur in this byte string, then `None` is returned.

methods.name: find_iter
methods.signature: fn find_iter<'h, 'n, B: ?Sized + AsRef<[u8]>>(&'h self, needle: &'n B) -> Find<'h, 'n>
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of the non-overlapping occurrences of the given needle. The iterator yields byte offset positions indicating the start of each match.

methods.name: find_non_ascii_byte
methods.summary: Returns the index of the first non-ASCII byte in this byte string (if any such indices exist). Specifically, it returns the index of the first byte with a value greater than or equal to `0x80`.

methods.name: find_not_byteset
methods.signature: fn find_not_byteset<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, byteset: B) -> Option<usize>
methods.summary: Returns the index of the first occurrence of a byte that is not a member of the provided set.

methods.name: from_os_str
methods.summary: Create an immutable byte string from an OS string slice.

methods.name: from_path
methods.summary: Create an immutable byte string from a file path.

methods.name: grapheme_indices
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the grapheme clusters in this byte string along with their starting and ending byte index positions. If invalid UTF-8 is encountered, then the Unicode replacement codepoint is yielded instead.

methods.name: graphemes
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the grapheme clusters in this byte string. If invalid UTF-8 is encountered, then the Unicode replacement codepoint is yielded instead.

methods.name: is_ascii
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if every byte in this byte string is ASCII.

methods.name: is_utf8
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if the entire byte string is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: last_byte
methods.summary: Returns the last byte in this byte string, if it's non-empty. If this byte string is empty, this returns `None`.

methods.name: lines
methods.summary: An iterator over all lines in a byte string, without their terminators.

methods.name: lines_with_terminator
methods.summary: An iterator over all lines in a byte string, including their terminators.

methods.name: make_ascii_lowercase
methods.summary: Convert this byte string to its lowercase ASCII equivalent in place.

methods.name: make_ascii_uppercase
methods.summary: Convert this byte string to its uppercase ASCII equivalent in place.

methods.name: repeatn
methods.summary: Create a new byte string by repeating this byte string `n` times.

methods.name: replace_into
methods.signature: fn replace_into<N: AsRef<[u8]>, R: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, needle: N, replacement: R, dest: &mut Vec<u8>)
methods.summary: Replace all matches of the given needle with the given replacement, and write the result into the provided `Vec<u8>`.

methods.signature: fn replacen<N: AsRef<[u8]>, R: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, needle: N, replacement: R, limit: usize) -> Vec<u8>
methods.summary: Replace up to `limit` matches of the given needle with the given replacement, and the result as a new `Vec<u8>`.

methods.name: replacen_into
methods.signature: fn replacen_into<N: AsRef<[u8]>, R: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, needle: N, replacement: R, limit: usize, dest: &mut Vec<u8>)
methods.summary: Replace up to `limit` matches of the given needle with the given replacement, and write the result into the provided `Vec<u8>`.

methods.name: reverse_bytes
methods.summary: Reverse the bytes in this string, in place.

methods.name: reverse_chars
methods.summary: Reverse the codepoints in this string, in place.

methods.name: reverse_graphemes
methods.summary: Reverse the graphemes in this string, in place.

methods.name: rfind
methods.signature: fn rfind<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, needle: B) -> Option<usize>
methods.summary: Returns the index of the last occurrence of the given needle.

methods.name: rfind_byte
methods.summary: Returns the index of the last occurrence of the given byte. If the byte does not occur in this byte string, then `None` is returned.

methods.name: rfind_byteset
methods.signature: fn rfind_byteset<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, byteset: B) -> Option<usize>
methods.summary: Returns the index of the last occurrence of any of the bytes in the provided set.

methods.name: rfind_char
methods.summary: Returns the index of the last occurrence of the given codepoint. If the codepoint does not occur in this byte string, then `None` is returned.

methods.name: rfind_iter

methods.name: rfind_not_byteset
methods.signature: fn rfind_not_byteset<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(&self, byteset: B) -> Option<usize>
methods.summary: Returns the index of the last occurrence of a byte that is not a member of the provided set.

methods.summary: Returns an iterator over substrings of this byte string, separated by the given byte string, in reverse. Each element yielded is guaranteed not to include the splitter substring.

methods.name: rsplitn_str

methods.summary: Returns an iterator of at most `limit` substrings of this byte string, separated by the given byte string, in reverse. If `limit` substrings are yielded, then the last substring will contain the remainder of this byte string.

methods.name: split_once_str

methods.name: splitn_str
